Семь сборок одного коммита

Вы узнаете

Почему семь сборок одного коммита дали t27c четыре разных бинарника и как проверяется модель причин.

Семь сборок одного коммита дали t27c четыре разных бинарника, а t27b один: из 21 пары сборок t27c отличаются 17. Всё объяснили два входа, не являющихся исходником: длина git-хеша, зашитого в бинарник, 7 символов в клоне глубины 1 и 9 в полном, и путь кэша cargo, абсолютный путь которого rustc записывает в места паники. predicts_same говорит, чего модель причин ждёт от каждой пары, а mispredicts считает пары, в которых она ошибается: две названные причины ошибаются в 0, а один хост в 7. С флагом, переназначающим путь кэша, 3 сборки дали один хеш.

Попробовать

Выберите t27c и один хост и прочитайте, в скольких парах он ошибается. Потом выберите две причины, а затем переключитесь на t27b без причины.

Открыть интерактивный урок →

Seven builds of one commit gave t27c four different binaries and t27b one. Pick a binary and a cause model: it explains the builds only if it gets no pair of builds wrong.

specs/compiler/theory/reproducible.t27

; specs/compiler/theory/reproducible.t27 -- sieve C9, first evidence: gen-c output determinism
; of one t27c binary (gHashTag/t27 #6517, epic #6488, sieve filter C9 in sieve.t27).
; ASCII only (L3). Every spec carries tests (L4).

; The owner's order (2026-10-05, translated): compare compilers along the sieve axes and state the
; conclusions as theorems. C9 (reproducible builds; reproducible-builds.org/docs/definition: the same
; source, environment and instructions give bit-identical artifacts) is UNKNOWN for t27c in the
; sieve matrix. This module records the first piece of evidence collectible with t27c alone.

; THE RUN
; Binary: ./target/release/t27c, t27c 0.4.0, built from gHashTag/t27 master commit d5b046b00
; (2026-10-06, cargo build --release -p t27c). Host: the owner's Mac, Darwin 25.5.0 arm64.
; Method: for each spec below, `t27c gen-c <spec> > out.1.c` then `t27c gen-c <spec> > out.2.c`,
; then `cmp out.1.c out.2.c`. All 12 specs listed by #6517 exist on that commit; 0 skipped.
; Result: all 12 pairs byte-identical. Sizes, bytes: sieve 14156, toolchain 19042,
; isa_round_trip 19657, ternary_encoding 17856, assembler 11190, steward 27372, priority 7136,
; t27core 50883, constants 17583, gf16 110604, types 53250, linker 10468.
; Negative control: gen-c of specs/queen/priority.t27 vs specs/compiler/theory/sieve.t27,
; same binary: `cmp` exits 1 (they differ at char 109, line 2), so the comparison can see a
; difference and the 12 identicals are not a cmp artifact.

; WHAT THIS IS NOT
; This is output determinism of ONE t27c binary run twice on the same host. It is not a bit-identical
; BUILD of t27c itself: that needs two independent builds of t27c from the same source (different
; paths or timestamps) compared byte for byte. That is the second part of this module (#8148,
; below); DDC #6508 is the stronger form.

module CompilerTheoryReproducible;

pub const SPECS_RUN : u32 = 12;

; Index i names the spec in the order of #6517:
; 0 sieve.t27, 1 toolchain.t27, 2 isa_round_trip.t27, 3 ternary_encoding.t27, 4 assembler.t27,
; 5 steward.t27, 6 priority.t27, 7 t27core.t27, 8 constants.t27, 9 gf16.t27, 10 types.t27,
; 11 linker.t27 (all under specs/, full paths in the run comment above).

pub fn spec_count() -> u32 {
    return SPECS_RUN;
}

; True when the two gen-c outputs of spec i were byte-identical in the recorded run.

pub fn identical(i: u32) -> bool {
    if (i < SPECS_RUN) { return true; }
    return false;
}

; The negative control: two DIFFERENT specs whose gen-c outputs differ (cmp exit 1). Kept as a
; function so the test asserts the recorded observation, not a constant the compiler folds away.

pub fn negative_control_pair(i: u32) -> u32 {
    if (i == 0) { return 6; }
    if (i == 1) { return 0; }
    return 4294967295;
}

test c9_all_recorded_runs_identical {
    var i : u32 = 0;
    var identical_count : u32 = 0;
    while (i < spec_count()) {
        if (identical(i)) { identical_count = identical_count + 1; }
        i = i + 1;
    }
    assert identical_count == 12;
    assert spec_count() == 12;
}

test c9_negative_control_differs {
    var a : u32 = negative_control_pair(0);
    var b : u32 = negative_control_pair(1);
    assert a != b;
    assert identical(a);
    assert identical(b);
}

; ==================================================================================================
; SECOND EVIDENCE: SEVEN BUILDS OF THE BINARIES (gHashTag/t27 #8148, epic #6488)
; ==================================================================================================

; THE RULE (what C9 means for t27). After reproducible-builds.org/docs/definition: a binary is TRUE
; on C9 when every recorded build of one commit, with one rustc and cargo, for one target, gives
; the same sha256, while the builds vary what belongs neither to the source nor to the
; instructions: the build directory, the clock, the user and HOME, TZ, locale, umask,
; SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH (set and unset), how the commit was fetched (partial, full or depth-1 clone),
; where the dependency cache sits (CARGO_HOME) and the host. It is FALSE when two such builds
; differ AND a named input explains every pair (the cause model below); with fewer than two builds,
; or differences no named input explains, it stays UNKNOWN. The cache path and the clone depth are
; varied inputs, not part of a fixed environment: a second party rebuilding from source has neither
; our CARGO_HOME nor our clone, and actions/checkout clones at depth 1.

; THE RUNS (2026-10-09). Commit be9757784eb0b47f5fb5cb8950044d8dfbeb1681 (master, Merge #8090).
; rustc 1.99.0 (b940084d7 2026-09-28), cargo 1.99.0 (5f94df478 2026-08-27), target
; x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, `cargo build --release -p t27c` and `-p t27b`, on two Railway labs:
; host 0 = the t27c lab (9d133cebfa89), host 1 = the t27b lab (9b1d552cadaa), 48 cores each.
; Seven plain builds, index b:
;   0 A  host 0, /tmp/c9r-20261009/a/t27, blob:none partial clone, root, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH unset,
;        CARGO_HOME /data/cargo, 10:17Z.
;   1 B  host 0, /tmp/c9r-20261009/second-build-dir/x/t27, full clone, `env -i`, USER c9b with its
;        own HOME, TZ Asia/Tokyo, LANG=C LC_ALL=C, umask 027, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1700000000,
;        CARGO_HOME /data/cargo, 11:26Z (its 10:20Z attempt failed in git clone; see the gen
;        negative control below).
;   2 C  host 0, /tmp/c9r-20261009/c/t27, depth-1 clone, root, CARGO_HOME /data/cargo, 10:20Z.
;   3 D  host 0, /tmp/c9r-20261009/d/t27, depth-1 clone with `git config core.abbrev 9`, root,
;        CARGO_HOME /data/cargo, 10:22Z.
;   4 E  host 0, /tmp/c9r-20261009/e/t27, a copy of A's tree, root, a fresh CARGO_HOME
;        /tmp/c9r-20261009/cargo-e, 10:23Z.
;   5 X  host 1, /tmp/c9r-20261009/x/t27, blob:none partial clone, root, CARGO_HOME
;        /usr/local/cargo, 10:18Z.
;   6 Y  host 1, /tmp/c9r-20261009/another/longer/path/t27, full clone, USER c9y with its own HOME,
;        TZ America/Los_Angeles, LANG=C LC_ALL=C, umask 027, SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1700000000,
;        CARGO_HOME /usr/local/cargo, 10:22Z.
; sha256 of target/release/t27c and t27b (full digests here; the data below keeps the first 64 bits):
;   t27c A B D  c661e5ecb47253034b7852eba12ef57749482164c008728850a3bfac42058feb  11794832 bytes
;   t27c C      477efb0f10d18854332970f60ff8c322e825259052a4ad9b1245501ee82b20e9  11794856 bytes
;   t27c E      5f3278089fdcdc7885fde7d930be27b14eb624ae0def81a2f4cfe3ea44c85cf0  11793392 bytes
;   t27c X Y    ac69ce14528151a3d85516274a25a176b7cdad0629a9c7ed4f94782272400cd4
;   t27b all 7  258950de2fa4a978a3c223cee4760b7912db8c022c4999d883bf9d4392a157cd   2932440 bytes
;   t27b X Y, `--target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu` (linker aarch64-linux-gnu-gcc):
;               b0917f8870d899911e19376b4f924d67a4b6b2a9a1bbdcbe327506f0812d9bd7

; THE CAUSES (t27c). `cmp -l` counts 1107995 differing bytes between A and C and 9964525 between A
; and E. Two inputs, each isolated by a build that changes it alone:
;   1. The git abbreviation. bootstrap/build.rs bakes `git rev-parse --short HEAD` into the binary
;      (T27C_BUILD_GIT, the `t27c-bootstrap@0.5.2+<sha>` string that seals and receipts carry). Git
;      sizes the abbreviation by the clone's object count: A, B, D, E, X and Y carry `+be9757784`,
;      the depth-1 clone C carries `+be97577`. D is a depth-1 clone too, with core.abbrev 9, and
;      gives A's hash, so the length alone made C differ.
;   2. The CARGO_HOME path. rustc writes the absolute source path of crates.io dependencies into
;      panic locations: 115 occurrences from 20 crates (regex-automata 38, clap_builder 15,
;      aho-corasick 15, chrono 13, regex-syntax 9, ...). E is A's tree with another CARGO_HOME and
;      differs; X and Y (CARGO_HOME /usr/local/cargo) agree with each other and differ from A. No
;      build directory and no rustup path is in the binaries; the only toolchain path is
;      /rustc/b940084d7....
; t27b has neither: it has no build script, and its one dependency, serde, leaves no path behind.

; THE FIX, MEASURED (#8178). With RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$CARGO_HOME=/cargo" three t27c
; builds, F (host 0, CARGO_HOME cargo-e), G (host 0, /data/cargo) and Z (host 1, /usr/local/cargo),
; all give 253be263e8c28ec9f6c4c659b9dbc979d42627a7799d915ec0d53366ab3809f6, with 0 absolute
; CARGO_HOME occurrences left and 115 `/cargo/registry` ones: with the flag neither the host nor the
; cache path reaches the binary. (cargo's own trim-paths is unstable in cargo 1.99.0:
; CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_TRIM_PATHS=all exits 101.) The abbreviation needs build.rs to cut the full
; `git rev-parse HEAD` to a fixed length; that is a foreign-code edit and waits on #8178.

; GEN, GEN-C, GEN-RUST OVER THE CORPUS. Every git-tracked *.t27 file of the commit (2038 files),
; each output stored under its path with `/` replaced by `_`. Two files map to one name that way,
; so 2037 output slots are compared and that pair is not compared separately. For each slot the
; stdout, the stderr and the exit code are compared. Runs: A1 and A2 (binary A twice), B, C and E,
; which is three distinct t27c binaries (A = B, C, E). Exit 0: gen 1992, gen-c 1988, gen-rust 1992
; of 2037 in every run. All five runs agree on every slot, stream and code, for all three backends.
; sha256 of the stdout manifest per backend: gen 2eb5cfd47b775ff99d5f264662184a2ce4b42e85...,
; gen-c bc1f4951415a3f03ec1d1c484a1ba23a46790272..., gen-rust 5155b323335c55a88940a69b58a6c6a7....
; Generated code does not carry the git identity, so neither cause reaches it.
; Negative control: B's first attempt had no clone (git: HTTP/2 PROTOCOL_ERROR), its 2037 slots
; were empty, and the comparison reported all 2037 slots different for every stream and backend: it
; can see a difference, so the agreement above is not an artifact of the comparison.

; VERDICT. t27b C9 TRUE: seven builds, two hosts, every varied input, one hash; the aarch64 cross
; build agrees across its two builds. t27c C9 FALSE: causes 1 and 2, fix issue #8178. Under one
; CARGO_HOME and one abbreviation length t27c is identical (A = B = D, across path, clock, user,
; HOME, TZ, locale, umask and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH). gen, gen-c and gen-rust are deterministic across
; runs and across three distinct binaries. sieve.t27 reads its two C9 cells from here.

pub const FALSE3 : u8 = 0;
pub const UNKNOWN3 : u8 = 1;
pub const TRUE3 : u8 = 2;

pub const BIN_T27C : u32 = 0;
pub const BIN_T27B : u32 = 1;
pub const BUILDS : u32 = 7;
pub const BUILD_PAIRS : u32 = 21;

; Varied inputs, per build b (0 A, 1 B, 2 C, 3 D, 4 E, 5 X, 6 Y).

pub fn build_host(b: u32) -> u32 {
    if (b >= 5) { return 1; }
    return 0;
}

; Characters of the git identity build.rs baked in.
pub fn build_abbrev(b: u32) -> u32 {
    if (b == 2) { return 7; }
    return 9;
}

; 0 /data/cargo, 1 /tmp/c9r-20261009/cargo-e, 2 /usr/local/cargo.
pub fn build_cargo_home(b: u32) -> u32 {
    if (b == 4) { return 1; }
    if (b >= 5) { return 2; }
    return 0;
}

; 0 blob:none partial clone, 1 full clone, 2 depth-1 clone, 3 copy of A's tree.
pub fn build_clone(b: u32) -> u32 {
    if (b == 1) { return 1; }
    if (b == 2) { return 2; }
    if (b == 3) { return 2; }
    if (b == 4) { return 3; }
    if (b == 6) { return 1; }
    return 0;
}

; SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1700000000 set, and the build ran as a non-root user with its own HOME, TZ,
; locale and umask 027 (B and Y); the others ran as root with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH unset.
pub fn build_env_varied(b: u32) -> bool {
    if (b == 1) { return true; }
    if (b == 6) { return true; }
    return false;
}

; Every build ran in its own directory.
pub fn build_dir(b: u32) -> u32 {
    return b;
}

; First 64 bits of the sha256 of each binary.

pub fn t27c_sha64(b: u32) -> u64 {
    if (b >= BUILDS) { return 0; }
    if (b == 2) { return 0x477efb0f10d18854; }
    if (b == 4) { return 0x5f3278089fdcdc78; }
    if (b >= 5) { return 0xac69ce14528151a3; }
    return 0xc661e5ecb4725303;
}

pub fn t27b_sha64(b: u32) -> u64 {
    if (b >= BUILDS) { return 0; }
    return 0x258950de2fa4a978;
}

; The aarch64 cross build of t27b, made on host 1 only (0 = not built).
pub fn t27b_aarch64_sha64(b: u32) -> u64 {
    if (b == 5) { return 0xb0917f8870d89991; }
    if (b == 6) { return 0xb0917f8870d89991; }
    return 0;
}

pub fn sha64(bin: u32, b: u32) -> u64 {
    if (bin == BIN_T27C) { return t27c_sha64(b); }
    return t27b_sha64(b);
}

pub fn pairs_differing(bin: u32) -> u32 {
    var n : u32 = 0;
    var i : u32 = 0;
    while (i < BUILDS) {
        var j : u32 = i + 1;
        while (j < BUILDS) {
            if (sha64(bin, i) != sha64(bin, j)) { n = n + 1; }
            j = j + 1;
        }
        i = i + 1;
    }
    return n;
}

; Cause models: does model m predict builds i and j give the same binary?
;   0 CAUSE: same abbreviation and same CARGO_HOME (the named causes of t27c)
;   1 the CARGO_HOME alone, 2 the abbreviation alone, 3 the host alone
;   4 NONE: every build the same (the model of a reproducible binary)
pub const MODEL_CAUSE : u32 = 0;
pub const MODEL_NO_ABBREV : u32 = 1;
pub const MODEL_NO_CARGO_HOME : u32 = 2;
pub const MODEL_HOST_ONLY : u32 = 3;
pub const MODEL_NONE : u32 = 4;

pub fn predicts_same(m: u32, i: u32, j: u32) -> bool {
    var same_abbrev : bool = build_abbrev(i) == build_abbrev(j);
    var same_home : bool = build_cargo_home(i) == build_cargo_home(j);
    if (m == MODEL_CAUSE) {
        if (same_abbrev) { return same_home; }
        return false;
    }
    if (m == MODEL_NO_ABBREV) { return same_home; }
    if (m == MODEL_NO_CARGO_HOME) { return same_abbrev; }
    if (m == MODEL_HOST_ONLY) { return build_host(i) == build_host(j); }
    return true;
}

; Pairs where model m is wrong about binary bin.
pub fn mispredicts(m: u32, bin: u32) -> u32 {
    var n : u32 = 0;
    var i : u32 = 0;
    while (i < BUILDS) {
        var j : u32 = i + 1;
        while (j < BUILDS) {
            var same : bool = sha64(bin, i) == sha64(bin, j);
            if (same != predicts_same(m, i, j)) { n = n + 1; }
            j = j + 1;
        }
        i = i + 1;
    }
    return n;
}

; The C9 cell of a binary, in sieve.t27's Kleene encoding.
pub fn c9_verdict(bin: u32) -> u8 {
    if (BUILDS < 2) { return UNKNOWN3; }
    if (pairs_differing(bin) == 0) { return TRUE3; }
    if (mispredicts(MODEL_CAUSE, bin) == 0) { return FALSE3; }
    return UNKNOWN3;
}

; The fix (#8178), measured: three builds with --remap-path-prefix=$CARGO_HOME=/cargo,
; r = 0 F (host 0, cargo-e), 1 G (host 0, /data/cargo), 2 Z (host 1, /usr/local/cargo).
pub const REMAP_BUILDS : u32 = 3;

pub fn remap_host(r: u32) -> u32 {
    if (r == 2) { return 1; }
    return 0;
}

pub fn remap_cargo_home(r: u32) -> u32 {
    if (r == 0) { return 1; }
    if (r == 1) { return 0; }
    return 2;
}

pub fn remap_t27c_sha64(r: u32) -> u64 {
    if (r < REMAP_BUILDS) { return 0x253be263e8c28ec9; }
    return 0;
}

; gen corpus: run r = 0 A1, 1 A2, 2 B, 3 C, 4 E; backend k = 0 gen, 1 gen-c, 2 gen-rust.
pub const GEN_RUNS : u32 = 5;
pub const GEN_BACKENDS : u32 = 3;
pub const GEN_FILES : u32 = 2038;
pub const GEN_SLOTS : u32 = 2037;

pub fn gen_run_build(r: u32) -> u32 {
    if (r == 2) { return 1; }
    if (r == 3) { return 2; }
    if (r == 4) { return 4; }
    return 0;
}

; First 64 bits of the sha256 of the stdout manifest (0 = no such run).
pub fn gen_manifest64(r: u32, k: u32) -> u64 {
    if (r >= GEN_RUNS) { return 0; }
    if (k == 0) { return 0x2eb5cfd47b775ff9; }
    if (k == 1) { return 0xbc1f4951415a3f03; }
    if (k == 2) { return 0x5155b323335c55a8; }
    return 0;
}

pub fn gen_exit0(r: u32, k: u32) -> u32 {
    if (r >= GEN_RUNS) { return 0; }
    if (k == 1) { return 1988; }
    return 1992;
}

; Slots that differed from A1, per stream and backend (all three streams gave the same count).
; The failed first B attempt, which produced no output, is kept as run 5.
pub fn gen_slots_differing(r: u32, k: u32) -> u32 {
    if (k >= GEN_BACKENDS) { return 0; }
    if (r == 5) { return GEN_SLOTS; }
    return 0;
}

test c9_t27b_is_bit_identical_across_every_varied_input {
    assert pairs_differing(BIN_T27B) == 0;
    assert c9_verdict(BIN_T27B) == TRUE3;
    assert mispredicts(MODEL_NONE, BIN_T27B) == 0;
    assert t27b_aarch64_sha64(5) == t27b_aarch64_sha64(6);
    assert t27b_aarch64_sha64(5) != 0;
    assert t27b_aarch64_sha64(5) != t27b_sha64(5);
}

test c9_t27c_differs_and_the_two_causes_explain_every_pair {
    assert pairs_differing(BIN_T27C) == 17;
    assert mispredicts(MODEL_CAUSE, BIN_T27C) == 0;
    assert c9_verdict(BIN_T27C) == FALSE3;
    assert sha64(BIN_T27C, 0) == sha64(BIN_T27C, 1);
    assert sha64(BIN_T27C, 0) == sha64(BIN_T27C, 3);
    assert sha64(BIN_T27C, 5) == sha64(BIN_T27C, 6);
}

; Each cause is isolated by a pair of builds that differ in it alone among the inputs that matter.
; A and C: same host and CARGO_HOME, abbreviation 9 against 7, and they differ. C and D: both
; depth-1 clones; core.abbrev 9 brings D back to A's hash. A and E: same tree, host and
; abbreviation, another CARGO_HOME, and they differ.
test c9_each_cause_is_isolated_by_one_pair {
    assert build_host(0) == build_host(2);
    assert build_cargo_home(0) == build_cargo_home(2);
    assert build_abbrev(0) != build_abbrev(2);
    assert sha64(BIN_T27C, 0) != sha64(BIN_T27C, 2);
    assert build_clone(2) == build_clone(3);
    assert build_abbrev(3) == build_abbrev(0);
    assert sha64(BIN_T27C, 3) == sha64(BIN_T27C, 0);
    assert build_host(0) == build_host(4);
    assert build_abbrev(0) == build_abbrev(4);
    assert build_cargo_home(0) != build_cargo_home(4);
    assert sha64(BIN_T27C, 0) != sha64(BIN_T27C, 4);
}

; Negative controls: each model that drops a cause, or keeps only the host, is wrong on some pair,
; so the cause model's zero is earned; and the cause model is wrong about t27b, so it does not fit
; any data whatever.
test c9_negative_controls_wrong_models_mispredict {
    assert mispredicts(MODEL_NO_ABBREV, BIN_T27C) == 3;
    assert mispredicts(MODEL_NO_CARGO_HOME, BIN_T27C) == 11;
    assert mispredicts(MODEL_HOST_ONLY, BIN_T27C) == 7;
    assert mispredicts(MODEL_NONE, BIN_T27C) == 17;
    assert mispredicts(MODEL_CAUSE, BIN_T27B) == 17;
}

; Not vacuous: for every varied input, some pair of builds that differs in it gives one t27b hash.
test c9_every_varied_input_is_covered_by_an_equal_t27b_pair {
    var host : bool = false;
    var abbrev : bool = false;
    var home : bool = false;
    var clone : bool = false;
    var env : bool = false;
    var dir : bool = false;
    var i : u32 = 0;
    while (i < BUILDS) {
        var j : u32 = i + 1;
        while (j < BUILDS) {
            if (sha64(BIN_T27B, i) == sha64(BIN_T27B, j)) {
                if (build_host(i) != build_host(j)) { host = true; }
                if (build_abbrev(i) != build_abbrev(j)) { abbrev = true; }
                if (build_cargo_home(i) != build_cargo_home(j)) { home = true; }
                if (build_clone(i) != build_clone(j)) { clone = true; }
                if (build_env_varied(i) != build_env_varied(j)) { env = true; }
                if (build_dir(i) != build_dir(j)) { dir = true; }
            }
            j = j + 1;
        }
        i = i + 1;
    }
    assert host;
    assert abbrev;
    assert home;
    assert clone;
    assert env;
    assert dir;
}

; The remap fix crosses hosts and cache paths, and is a different binary from every plain build.
test c9_remap_fix_removes_the_cache_path_cause {
    var r : u32 = 0;
    var hosts : u32 = 0;
    var homes : u32 = 0;
    while (r < REMAP_BUILDS) {
        assert remap_t27c_sha64(r) == remap_t27c_sha64(0);
        hosts = hosts | (1 << remap_host(r));
        homes = homes | (1 << remap_cargo_home(r));
        var b : u32 = 0;
        while (b < BUILDS) {
            assert remap_t27c_sha64(r) != t27c_sha64(b);
            b = b + 1;
        }
        r = r + 1;
    }
    assert hosts == 3;
    assert homes == 7;
}

; Every run agrees with A1 per backend, and the five runs used three distinct t27c binaries
; (A = B, C, E).
test c9_gen_backends_are_deterministic_across_runs_and_binaries {
    var k : u32 = 0;
    while (k < GEN_BACKENDS) {
        var r : u32 = 0;
        while (r < GEN_RUNS) {
            assert gen_manifest64(r, k) == gen_manifest64(0, k);
            assert gen_exit0(r, k) == gen_exit0(0, k);
            assert gen_slots_differing(r, k) == 0;
            r = r + 1;
        }
        k = k + 1;
    }
    assert gen_exit0(0, 0) == 1992;
    assert gen_exit0(0, 1) == 1988;
    assert gen_exit0(0, 2) == 1992;
    assert GEN_SLOTS + 1 == GEN_FILES;
    var distinct : u32 = 0;
    var r2 : u32 = 0;
    while (r2 < GEN_RUNS) {
        var seen : bool = false;
        var q : u32 = 0;
        while (q < r2) {
            if (t27c_sha64(gen_run_build(q)) == t27c_sha64(gen_run_build(r2))) { seen = true; }
            q = q + 1;
        }
        if (seen == false) { distinct = distinct + 1; }
        r2 = r2 + 1;
    }
    assert distinct == 3;
}

; Negative control: the empty first B attempt differs on every slot, and the three backends'
; manifests differ from each other, so the comparison can see a difference.
test c9_gen_negative_control_sees_a_difference {
    assert gen_slots_differing(5, 0) == GEN_SLOTS;
    assert gen_slots_differing(5, 1) == GEN_SLOTS;
    assert gen_slots_differing(5, 2) == GEN_SLOTS;
    assert gen_manifest64(0, 0) != gen_manifest64(0, 1);
    assert gen_manifest64(0, 1) != gen_manifest64(0, 2);
    assert gen_manifest64(0, 0) != gen_manifest64(0, 2);
}

  • Модуль 1 · Чтение текста

    Компилятор начинает с байтов. Пять крошечных проверок разносят байт на букву, цифру или пробел, три сканера идут по строке, а число отвергается раньше, чем успеет переполниться.

    1. 01 Буква, цифра или пробел
    2. 02 Где кончается слово
    3. 03 Насколько велико может быть число

  • Модуль 2 · Форма и отказы

    Выражение читается через 11 вложенных уровней, в готовом выражении у оператора может пропасть правая часть, а отвергнутая строка получает одну из 7 пронумерованных причин.

    1. 04 Кто связывает крепче
    2. 05 Оператор, после которого пусто
    3. 06 Семь способов отказать строке

    Пока типов нет, компилятор видит тип как текст: его ширину, суффикс ли он, кортеж, который возьмёт бэкенд Verilog, и if/else, который является значением.

    1. 07 Что значит имя типа
    2. 08 Кортеж для Verilog
    3. 09 if, который является значением

  • Модуль 4 · Оценка стоимости

    Раньше, чем будет проложен хоть один провод, компилятор считает: задержку пути и допустимый такт, мощность ресурсов, длину провода и размер дерева тактов.

    1. 10 Насколько быстрый такт
    2. 11 Что он потребит
    3. 12 Провода и деревья тактов

  • Модуль 5 · Один ответ от каждого бэкенда

    Каждый случай закрепляет одну тихую ошибку компиляции: минус, потерявший скобку, общее значение, которое устарело, и байты, срезы и строки в бэкенде Rust.

    1. 13 Минус перед скобкой
    2. 14 Устаревшее значение
    3. 15 Байты, срезы и строки

    Компилятор пишет файлы, а файл может уже лежать на месте: когда его можно перезаписать, где должна стоять метка сгенерированного и что делать с выводом, который никто не пересобрал.

    2. 17 Метка сгенерированного файла
    3. 18 Закоммиченный вывод, который никто не пересобрал

    3. 21 Прогон, оборванный посреди печати

    Три вопроса о самом компиляторе: таблица из 9 компиляторов и 10 фильтров, 7 сборок одного коммита, которые не дали один бинарник, и пересборка 3 путями.
